verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents its own safe-testing mechanisms. It offers a shadow mode to verify capture before active delivery, previews of corrections and routing conditions against stored traces before activation, and holdout comparisons with rollback. These let users test changes without affecting live agent behavior. However, they run on stored or live production traces rather than in an isolated sandbox environment with non-production data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test environment separated from production data, test/staging API keys or projects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
